daten.vorteil.v_kulturnation.name: Cultural nation
daten.vorteil.v_kulturnation.text: A well-kept heritage and strong cohesion make the country a destination and a model.
daten.vorteil.v_kulturnation.kehrseite: The advantage only lasts as long as there is upkeep: if preservation slackens, it is lost.
daten.vorteil.v_land_der_vielfalt.name: Land of diversity
daten.vorteil.v_land_der_vielfalt.text: Minorities are visible and recognised; communities found associations, and partners in Europe see the country differently.
daten.vorteil.v_land_der_vielfalt.kehrse: Conservative voters see their majority culture relativised.
daten.vorteil.v_drehkreuz.name: Hub between Europe and Asia
daten.vorteil.v_drehkreuz.text: Airport, rail tunnel and bridges work together: the country is a transfer point for goods and travellers.
daten.vorteil.v_drehkreuz.kehrseite: The advantage depends on upkeep: if the condition of the facilities falls, it is lost.
daten.vorteil.v_land_der_bruecken.name: Land of great buildings
daten.vorteil.v_land_der_bruecken.text: Five completed major projects make the country a model: investors and builders trust the administration.
daten.vorteil.v_land_der_bruecken.kehrse: Great buildings raise expectations; delays and guarantees are closely watched abroad.
daten.vorteil.v_rechtsstaat.name: Rule-of-law dividend
daten.vorteil.v_rechtsstaat.text: Independent courts and predictable law: investors, partners and citizens trust the rules.
daten.vorteil.v_rechtsstaat.kehrseite: Independent courts are inconvenient: they also overturn the government's projects.
daten.vorteil.v_durchgriff.name: Firm grip
daten.vorteil.v_durchgriff.text: With emergency law and a guided judiciary, governing is fast, against terror and criticism alike.
daten.vorteil.v_durchgriff.kehrseite: An advantage with a price: it costs legitimacy and standing and vanishes as soon as emergency law ends.
daten.vorteil.v_regionale_macht.name: Regional power
daten.vorteil.v_regionale_macht.text: Readiness, equipment and alliance backing make the armed forces a factor everyone reckons with.
daten.vorteil.v_regionale_macht.kehrseit: A strong army raises expectations and mistrust: neighbours arm themselves.
daten.vorteil.v_ruestungsexporteur.name: Arms exporter
daten.vorteil.v_ruestungsexporteur.text: Domestic industry supplies customers around the world; the order books are full (2025: exports of 10.05 bn USD, order backlog 17.8 bn).
daten.vorteil.v_ruestungsexporteur.kehrs: Buyers have a say: exports to parties in conflict strain alliances and the country's standing.
daten.vorteil.v_solide_verwaltung.name: Sound administration
daten.vorteil.v_solide_verwaltung.text: An administration whose figures are believed: markets and citizens trust the course.
daten.vorteil.v_solide_verwaltung.kehrse: A reputation earned year after year and lost with one scandal.
daten.vorteil.v_raumfahrtnation.name: Spacefaring nation
daten.vorteil.v_raumfahrtnation.text: Own satellites, a launch site and a launch vehicle: the country is no longer just a customer in space.
daten.vorteil.v_raumfahrtnation.kehrseit: Rockets are dual-use: neighbours and the West watch every launch, and the costs keep running.
daten.vorteil.v_ki_standort.name: AI hub
daten.vorteil.v_ki_standort.text: Data centres, own chips and a domestic language model make the country a place where AI is created.
daten.vorteil.v_ki_standort.kehrseite: Dependent on a few chip suppliers and on electricity; surveillance and censorship are one step away.
daten.vorteil.v_korridormacht.name: Middle Corridor hub
daten.vorteil.v_korridormacht.text: Road and terminals link Anatolia with Central Asia: goods from China run through the country to Europe.
daten.vorteil.v_korridormacht.kehrseite: Whoever offers transit depends on the neighbours and on Beijing: every crisis along the route hits the country.
